basis.load_3d: torque and efficiency on the corrected shaft power
basis.fit: least squares through the origin, n in krpm

basis.kv_ex_2d: without {rpm} rpm, {n} rows, magnets at {mag} °C, not corrected yet

note.noBearings: no bearings assigned: set them in Mechanical, Shaft and bearings

group.fit: Loss fit P = a·n + b·n² (n in krpm)
group.kv_kt: Kv / Kt from the EMF slope, all {n} rows

row.no_noload: no no-load duty in this configuration
row.no_bearings: no bearings assigned to this configuration
row.kv_slope: EMF slope, V line-line peak per 1000 rpm
row.kt: Kt per A rms phase current

tip.resistance: Simulated R_phase at its coil temperature, scaled to the measured temperature by (234.5 + T), x2 line-to-line in star (2/3 in delta), plus the stated lead cables. The phase board and the joints are not in the simulation.
tip.ldq_sum: 3-pair mean of L line-line = Ld + Lq (star). Simulation = the incremental Ld/Lq of the lowest-current duty.
tip.ldq_amp: 3-pair amplitude √(2/3·Σdev²) = |Lq − Ld|. The pair order on the rotor is not known, so the smaller fitted value is compared with the smaller simulation value.
tip.l_rotor_out: Stator without rotor: compared with a stored stator-only run when one exists.
tip.l_freq: The simulation is low-frequency incremental; at kHz the eddy currents in iron and magnets lower the bench reading.
tip.emf_peak: Simulated V_LL peak of the no-load duty, x speed ratio, x Br(test magnet T) / Br(simulation magnet T), x the end-effect correction of the configuration (shown as "not corrected yet" when it has none). Measured = Vpp / 2.
tip.emf_rms: Simulated V_LL rms of the no-load duty, same speed, Br and correction.
tip.bearings: Simulation values, not a measurement: SKF friction of the bearings assigned to the configuration, the rotor weight as the radial load, at the bench speed and temperature. The only measured figure is the total free-run loss, in which the bearings are not separated.
tip.kv_kt: Slope of V line-line peak against speed, least squares through the origin over the rows named in the group. Kv = 1000 / slope, rpm per V of line-line peak. Kt = 3·Ke per A rms of phase current (Ke = phase rms EMF per rad/s; sine EMF, current on the q axis). The simulated values carry the end-effect correction of the configuration.
tip.loss: Simulation = core (hysteresis ~n, eddy ~n², excess ~n^1.5) + solid eddy (~n²) of the no-load duty, x (Br ratio)², + bearings (SKF) + windage. The rest of the measured power is unexplained.
tip.fit: Least squares P = a·n + b·n² through the origin, n in krpm.
tip.load: The duty within 2 % speed and 3 % current. Simulated torque is corrected by the torque factor (measured k_T, else the flux factor); simulated efficiency is the motor’s at the corrected shaft power (no inverter), system efficiency adds the stored inverter efficiency. A value shown as "not corrected yet" has no factor for this configuration.
tip.eff_system: Torque·ω / (V_dc·I_dc) includes the inverter: compared only with the stored system (wall-to-shaft) efficiency of the controller record, never with the motor’s.
tip.weight: Simulated mass of the configuration’s parts; the bench weighs what the record names.
tip.cogging: No-load cogging peak-to-peak. Simulation = the configuration’s stored cogging (I = 0, eddy and demagnetisation off, magnets at the stated temperature). Bench = break-away by hand through a torque meter in both directions, friction taken out.

editor.title: Title
editor.stateTip: What was done to the motor before the test, e.g. after the acid treatment.
editor.magnetTempTip: Magnet temperature during the test when known; the EMF is scaled to it.
editor.leadsTip: The cables between the winding and the meter; a line-to-line reading runs through two of them.
editor.pairsTip: Three values in the order of the label, separated by spaces or slashes.
editor.lcr: LCR: pair mode quantity value unit freq level
editor.lcrTip: One reading per line, e.g. 1-2 parallel R 12.5 Ohm 1000 0.5
editor.insulation: Insulation: V, MΩ (> if more than)
editor.cogPkpkTip: No-load cogging, peak-to-peak: turn the rotor by hand through a torque meter in both directions; take friction out (half the difference of the two directions).
editor.rowsTip: Paste the bench rows: 1000/140/80/28.3/40, 1500/240/120/42.4 ... or one row per line split by tabs. - = not measured.
